verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API to its data, including a list-items endpoint (GET /api/1/items) with filtering by level, environment, status and pagination. Its OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.rollbar.com includes Item and Occurrence resources, which covers raw event access. Token scoping is documented: a post_client_item token can only send events and cannot read data, alongside account and project access-token management. missing for 10: an explicit documented endpoint for updating items (status, owner) via the API, explicit occurrence-fetch endpoint details, a full enumeration of read/write token scopes, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
